title: decK dump smoke: decK metadata is accepted and key-auth with an explicitly included key works
claims: a decK dump (with _info metadata) converts with --from kong; no decK-specific flag is needed
with explicit credential inclusion, a request carrying the consumer's API key in the apikey header reaches backend a unchanged
a request with a wrong API key is not forwarded
a request without an API key is not forwarded
the synthetic API key appears only in the private resources file, never in the report, settings or converter output
not_claimed: replaying the dump into Kong with decK (decK fixtures stay documentation-inferred; see profiles/upstream.example.json)
API keys passed as query parameters
source_semantics: Kong key-auth: the key is read from the configured key name (header or query); a matching keyauth credential authenticates the consumer and the request is proxied, otherwise Kong answers 401. strip_path false forwards the path unchanged. The synthetic key is random per run and authorizes nothing outside the harness.
